verdict.rationale: The evidence documents hybrid search that returns the most relevant memories and chunks, plus auto-maintained user profiles. Nothing shows a single call that assembles those memories into a prompt-ready context block, and nothing shows token-budget control over the output. Search results and profiles are adjacent retrieval features, not the budgeted context-assembly capability the story names, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can retrieve a token-budgeted, prompt-ready context block assembled from relevant memories in one call
